title: FloMo: 3D Scene Flow as a World Action Model Intermediate for Learning from Human Video
abstract: arXiv:2611.05062v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Pretrained video generation models distill internet-scale motion priors into robot policies, but full video is a redundant signal for action prediction. We argue that dense 3D motion is the medium through which video pretraining best transfers to robot actions, and that predicting motion rather than video affords better sample-efficiency for action prediction. FloMo is a 5B video-generation model fine-tuned to predict 3D scene-flow and action tokens. Rendering scene flow as RGB and encoding it into the same latent space as video enables a pretrained video generation backbone to efficiently adapt to predict 3D scene flow. Co-trained on action-free human video and action-labeled robot teleoperation data, our model benefits from human-video pretraining and generalizes to unseen objects, motion primitives, and tasks. translated_title: FloMo：3D场景流作为从人类视频学习的世界动作模型中间表示
translated_abstract: 预训练视频生成模型能够将互联网规模的运动先验蒸馏到机器人策略中，但完整视频对于动作预测而言是一个冗余信号。我们认为，密集的3D运动是视频预训练最佳迁移到机器人动作的媒介，并且预测运动而非视频能为动作预测带来更好的样本效率。FloMo是一个50亿参数的视频生成模型，经过微调以预测3D场景流和动作token。将场景流渲染为RGB并将其编码到与视频相同的潜在空间中，使预训练的视频生成主干网络能够高效地适应预测3D场景流。通过在无动作标注的人类视频和有动作标注的机器人遥操作数据上联合训练，我们的模型受益于人类视频预训练，并能泛化到未见过的物体、运动基元和任务。用视频预测目标替代运动预测会降低分布外泛化能力，而添加……
tldr: FloMo提出以3D场景流作为视频预训练迁移到机器人动作预测的中间表示，通过将场景流渲染为RGB并与视频共享潜在空间，使50亿参数的视频生成模型能够联合利用无动作标注的人类视频和机器人遥操作数据进行训练，从而在未见过的物体、运动基元和任务上实现更好的泛化。
en_tdlr: FloMo proposes dense 3D scene flow as an intermediate representation for transferring video pretraining to robot action prediction, rendering scene flow as RGB in the shared video latent space so that a 5B video generation model, co-trained on action-free human video and robot teleoperation data, generalizes to unseen objects, motion primitives, and tasks.
